name: Epistemology

hypotheses: priors obey the probability axioms
the evidence is learned with certainty

tools.does: shows that degrees of belief violating the probability axioms allow a sure loss
hypotheses: degrees of belief are identified with betting prices
the agent accepts every bet judged fair
